title: job-hunt source plugin output
description: The JSON object that every job-hunt source plugin's fetch_postings() function must print on stdout.  The orchestrator (scripts/run.sh) validates this shape before accepting a source's output.

source.description: Plugin name; must match the filename stem (e.g. 'kr-wanted' for sources/kr-wanted.sh).  Accepts '_mock', '<locale>-<board>' (e.g. 'kr-wanted'), or 'global-<board>' (e.g. 'global-ats') for locale-agnostic aggregator plugins.

fetched_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of when the fetch was issued.  Use $(date -Iseconds) in live plugins; mock plugins should honor $JH_MOCK_FETCH_AT for deterministic output.

postings.description: Zero or more job postings.  Empty array is valid (e.g. when no filter matches at the upstream source); orchestrator handles dedupe and downstream filtering.

title.description: Job title as displayed by the source.

region.description: Location string in the source's native form.  For Korean sources, this is sido or sido + sigungu (e.g. '서울 강남구').  '원격' / 'Remote' are valid values.

posted_at.description: Date the posting was published.  Either ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) or full ISO-8601.  Source-dependent; orchestrator does not normalize.

url.description: Canonical posting URL.  Used as the dedupe key across sources, so identical postings exposed by multiple sources should share this value when possible.  In practice, sources rarely share posting IDs, so dedupe primarily catches within-source duplicates.

summary.description: Short description used for the keyword include/exclude filter.  May be empty.

apply_url.description: URL that lands the user on the apply flow.  Optional — if omitted, the orchestrator falls back to scripts/apply-assist.sh's derive_apply_url() lookup.

postings.title: 백엔드 개발자 (AI/LLM 통합)
postings.summary: Python/FastAPI 기반 LLM agent 통합 백엔드.
